name: pagerduty-mcp
title: PagerDuty
summary: Investigate and manage PagerDuty incidents, on-call schedules, services, teams, and escalation policies from AI agents.
description: The PagerDuty-hosted MCP server lets AI agents securely work with a PagerDuty account. Agents can list and triage incidents, check who is on call, look up services, teams, and escalation policies, review change events, and take actions such as acknowledging, resolving, or adding notes to incidents. All actions run with the permissions of the authenticated PagerDuty user. US and EU service regions are supported.

useCases.name: Real-time Alert Triage
useCases.description: Triage incoming alerts, acknowledge pages, and surface actionable signal from alert noise using ML-based signal intelligence.

useCases.name: On-Call & Escalation Visibility
useCases.description: Check on-call schedules, user assignments, escalation policies, and team structures directly inside AI workspaces without switching tools.

useCases.name: Telemetry & Signal Analysis
useCases.description: Query production telemetry, analyze critical service health, and inspect application logs across connected tools using natural language.

useCases.name: Root Cause Identification
useCases.description: Leverage shared operational memory and historical incident data to investigate failure modes, trace issues, and surface root causes quickly.

useCases.name: Lifecycle Orchestration
useCases.description: Declare incidents, track follow-ups, update incident statuses, and coordinate emergency responses without tab juggling.

useCases.name: Blended Team Collaboration
useCases.description: Facilitate seamless collaboration between human responders and AI agents (such as Paige, the SRE Agent) across chat tools and developer environments.

useCases.name: Automated Remediation Actions
useCases.description: Execute automated actions, restart services, and run Kubernetes remediations across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem infrastructure.

useCases.name: Post-Incident Review & Prevention
useCases.description: Conduct structured operational reviews, generate post-incident reviews automatically, and deliver platform insights back to developers to prevent future disruptions.

oauth2.description: PagerDuty OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE. Users sign in at identity.pagerduty.com and grant the app access to their account.

apiToken.description: PagerDuty User API token, sent as: Token token=<token>
apiToken.name: Authorization
